system.description:
-- Only for Uplifts & Synths --

Sculpted good looks are cheap and commonplace, but this morph possesses a physical look that can only be described as striking, fascinating, and unusual — even the gorgeous and chiseled glitterati take notice. Apply a +10 modifier to Persuade and Provoke tests where your allure may have an impact. 

Level 1 of this trait only applies to uplifts and synthmorphs; Level 2 is for humanoid biomorphs.
